hardware.subtitle: Settings for the scanner and receipt printer attached to this device. Each till keeps its own.
hardware.scanner_hint: Works with any USB or Bluetooth scanner that types like a keyboard (almost all of them). On the POS screen, a scan finds the product and adds it to the cart automatically.
hardware.enable_scan: Enable scanning on the POS screen
hardware.match_fields: Match a scanned code against (checked fields, in this order)
hardware.exact: Matches are exact (never partial), so a scan can't add the wrong part.
hardware.prefix: Strip prefix (if your scanner adds one)
hardware.test_ph: Click here, then scan a product (or type a code and press Enter)
hardware.no_match: No product matches “{{code}}” — check the product's barcode or SKU, or the mapping above.
hardware.printer_hint: Printing uses the browser's print dialog — pick your receipt printer there once and the browser remembers it for this site.
hardware.auto_print: Open the print dialog automatically after each POS sale
hardware.copies_hint: Set in the print dialog too if your driver ignores this.

print.subtitle: Create and customise templates, then assign a default for each document type. The preview updates as you change things.
print.needs_migration: Template customisation needs the Phase 15 database migration. Run it in Supabase to enable this page.
print.no_templates: No print templates have been set up for this company yet, so documents print with the standard layout. An administrator can create and customise templates here.
print.doc_defaults_hint: Choose which template prints for each document type. Leave on “Company default” to use the ★ default.
print.name: Template name
print.style_hint: Picking a style sets a matching palette — fine-tune below.
print.elegant_hint: Wording and photo for the Elegant design. Tip: write extra details in a document's Notes as “Label: value” separated by semicolons (e.g. “Event Date: 15 Nov 2026; Venue: City Hall”) and they print as rows under the client details.
print.elegant_desc: Big title beside a header photo, rounded panels, contact footer bar.
print.logo_hint: Shown at the top of documents when “Company logo” is enabled. Shared with your
print.letterhead_hint: Already have a designed letterhead? Upload it as an A4 portrait image (PNG or JPG, ideally 2480 × 3508 px) and every document using this template prints on top of it. Exporting a PDF letterhead? Save its first page as an image.
print.letterhead_spaces_hint: Adjust the spaces until the preview's text sits clear of your letterhead's design. Remember to save the template.
print.payment_terms_hint: The text shown on documents when “Payment terms” is enabled below. In the Elegant layout each line becomes a bullet.
print.bank_hint: Shown in the “Payment Details” block when “Bank / payment details” is enabled below.
print.signature_hint: The label under the signing line when “Signature block” is enabled below.
print.hero_words: Words beside the photo (one per line)
print.terms: Terms and conditions (one per line — a document's own terms replace these)
print.acceptance: Show a customer acceptance box (name, date, signature)
print.lh_hide: Hide StockBolt's logo and company details (my letterhead already shows them)
print.sample_note: Sample data. Real documents use your own logo, company details and figures.
print.err_delete_default: Cannot delete the default template. Set another template as default first.
print.confirm_delete: Delete template “{{name}}”? This cannot be undone.

users.invited: Invitation created for {{email}}. Ask them to sign up with this email.
users.name: Name
users.customize_title: Allow or deny specific options for this person on top of their role

users.duplicate_title: Copy this role into an editable custom role
users.role_in_use: “{{name}}” is assigned to {{count}} member(s) — reassign them first.
users.footer: Invited teammates sign up with the same email and are added to your company with the role you chose. Click a role to see or change what it can access — system roles are shared templates, so use “Duplicate and customize” to make your own editable copy. Use “Customize” on a member to grant or deny specific modules for just that person. Members only ever see what their role and overrides allow.
users.override_hint: Tick to grant, untick to remove — anything different from the role becomes a personal override for {{name}}.
users.no_overrides: No overrides — matches the role exactly.
users.system_note: This is a built-in system role shared by all companies, so it can't be changed directly. Duplicate it to get your own editable copy.
users.admin_only_role: User management stays Admin-only and can't be granted to a custom role.

health.je_desc: These journal entries are out of balance. Click an entry number to inspect the source document. To fix, void and repost the source document (invoice, bill, payment, etc.) — or post a manual reversing entry.
health.repair_title: Re-derive the missing GL rows and stock movement from the underlying vendor bill
health.manual_title: Automatic repair supports vendor bill entries only
health.ar_desc: These customers have a difference between what the AR aging says they owe and what GL 1200 says. Common cause: an unlinked credit note, or an advance applied to an invoice that was later voided. Click the customer name to inspect their statement.
health.stock_desc: For each product, the latest running quantity × MAC should equal the sum of all its stock movements. A drift usually means a stock row was written with a different unit cost than the GL entry. Click the product name to inspect its stock ledger.

reset.subtitle: Destructive admin operation for testing. A true clean slate — wipes ALL transactions AND ALL setup masters (bank accounts, warehouses, units, brands, etc.). Only your company, profile and the seed chart of accounts survive.
reset.admin_only: Only an admin can reset company data. Your role is {{role}}.
reset.express_hint: Skip the type-the-name step so you can wipe in one click during testing. The server still checks admin and the company name. Remembered in this browser.
reset.deleted_intro: The following will be permanently deleted:
reset.w1: All invoices, quotes, sales orders, credit notes and sales returns
reset.w2: All vendor bills, purchase orders, goods receipts and debit notes
reset.w3: All customer and vendor payments and their allocations
reset.w4: All bank transfers, expenses, post-dated cheques and POS sessions
reset.w5: All stock transfers and inventory adjustments
reset.w6: All journal entries, the general ledger, the stock ledger and bank reconciliations
reset.w7: All customers, suppliers and products (with serials, compatibility and supplier codes)
reset.w8: All attachments, notifications and document sequences (reset to 1000)
reset.w9: All audit log entries (one final entry recording this reset is kept)
reset.w10: All setup masters — bank accounts, warehouses, units, categories, brands, vehicles, price levels, tax rates, payment methods, salespeople and print templates
reset.w11: All custom chart-of-account rows you added (e.g. 1111 ADCB). The seed accounts (1100, 1110, 1200, 2400, 3010, etc.) are kept because postings reference them by code.
reset.kept_intro: The following will be kept (structurally required):
reset.k1: Your company record, your user profile and onboarding state
reset.k2: The seed chart of accounts (system accounts only — needed by every posting)
reset.after: True clean slate. After the reset you'll need to recreate bank accounts, tax rates, warehouses and any custom accounts before booking new transactions.
reset.failed_hint: Also check the browser DevTools Console and Network tab for the underlying error (look for the request to
reset.resetting_long: Resetting… this may take a few seconds.
reset.express_on: Express mode is on — the button below wipes data after a single browser confirmation for
reset.type_name: To confirm, type the company name exactly:
reset.confirm_body: Wipe ALL transactional data for “{{name}}”? This cannot be undone. Click OK to proceed.
